name: brutalism-ui
description: Neubrutalist restyling — the flat-and-stark language that ADDS weight, and is defined by the absence of blur. Emits a border-first token layer with a six-step zero-blur hard-shadow scale, rewrites components to border-plus-offset surfaces with the hover-into-its-own-shadow interaction, flips the border token to a light ink in dark mode, and self-audits every emitted pair against WCAG 2.2. A request to strip ornament, quieten the palette or reduce to hairlines is minimalism-ui; one stacking loud layers over a patterned ground is maximalism-ui.
